description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data across six categories, labeled 0 through 6, with each slice representing a distinct segment of the dataset. The largest segment, labeled "6 Matches," accounts for 27.2% of the total, corresponding to a value of 8006. The second-largest segment, labeled "1," represents 13.8% (4046), followed by the segment labeled "0," which makes up 13.3% (3910). The segment labeled "2" constitutes 22.4% (6583), while "3" accounts for 6.8% (2002), and "4" represents 6.2% (1810). The smallest segment, labeled "5," comprises 10.4% (3043). The slices are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top, with the largest slice positioned at the top-left and the smallest at the bottom-right. Each slice is color-coded with a distinct pastel shade, and the percentage and value are clearly labeled within or adjacent to each segment. The chart effectively visualizes the relative proportions of the six categories, highlighting the dominance of the "6 Matches" and "2" categories in the dataset.
